CREATE TABLE "room_message_attachment_chunks" (
    attachment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "room_message_attachments"(attachment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence >= 0 AND sequence < 800),
    content BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(content)='blob' AND length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    PRIMARY KEY(attachment_id, sequence)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE "room_connector_upload_chunks" (
    attachment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "room_connector_uploads"(attachment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence >= 0 AND sequence < 800),
    content BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(content)='blob' AND length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    PRIMARY KEY(attachment_id, sequence)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE "room_message_attachment_previews" (
    attachment_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "room_message_attachments"(attachment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    content_type TEXT, content BLOB,
    CHECK((content_type IS NULL AND content IS NULL) OR
        (content_type IS NOT NULL AND content_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/webp')
        AND content IS NOT NULL AND typeof(content)='blob' AND length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 262144))
)

CREATE TABLE "room_connector_upload_previews" (
    attachment_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "room_connector_uploads"(attachment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    content_type TEXT, content BLOB,
    CHECK((content_type IS NULL AND content IS NULL) OR
        (content_type IS NOT NULL AND content_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/webp')
        AND content IS NOT NULL AND typeof(content)='blob' AND length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 262144))
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS delegated_action_requests (room_id TEXT NOT NULL, confirmation_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, delegate_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','declined','expired','cancelled','executing','succeeded','failed')), binding_json TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, decision_json TEXT, receipt_json TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(room_id,confirmation_id), UNIQUE(room_id,delegate_id,request_id), FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms(room_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member_resume_keys (
    issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
    person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    registration_epoch TEXT NOT NULL,
    browser_credential_fingerprint BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(browser_credential_fingerprint) = 32),
    resume_public_key BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(resume_public_key) = 65),
    issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(issuer, person_id, browser_credential_fingerprint)
) STRICT
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS member_resume_keys_lookup_idx ON member_resume_keys(browser_credential_fingerprint, resume_public_key)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_memory_pieces (room_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, from_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(from_seq > 0), to_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(to_seq >= from_seq), summary TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(summary) BETWEEN 1 AND 12000), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(hidden IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(room_id, session_id, from_seq), FOREIGN KEY(room_id, session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(room_id, session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS connector_avatar_assets (asset_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(asset_id) = 35 AND substr(asset_id, 1, 3) = 'aa_' AND substr(asset_id, 4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), room_id TEXT NOT NULL, participant_id TEXT NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL, content_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(content_type = 'image/png'), content BLOB NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760 AND length(content) = size), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending', 'current')), expires_at INTEGER, CHECK((state = 'pending' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR (state = 'current' AND expires_at IS NULL)), UNIQUE(room_id, participant_id, state), FOREIGN KEY(room_id, participant_id) REFERENCES participants(room_id, participant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
